org_defaults_intro: What you set here is inherited by new tours and by drafts that have not customised it.

author: Author

pano_preview_hint: Drag to look around and scroll to zoom. This is a quick check: it does not create a scene.
title: Title
trash_note: Trashed projects are permanently deleted after 30 days.
drop_files: Drop files here or click to upload
no_hotspots_yet: No hotspots in this scene yet.
drag_scene_hint: Drag a scene here to create the step towards it
social_intro: What people see when they paste the tour link into WhatsApp, X, Teams or the virtual campus.
social_title_hint: Left empty, the tour title is used.
social_description_hint: Two lines at most: networks truncate.
social_image_hint: 1200 × 630 px. Without an image almost no network shows a large card.
social_noindex_desc: Adds robots noindex. Useful for internal or unfinished tours.
hotspot_desc_navigation: Goes to another scene. It is the step of the tour.
hotspot_desc_link: Opens a web address, a phone number or an email.
hotspot_desc_state: Changes a tour variable and can jump to a scene.
hotspot_desc_polygon: Marks a free-form area over the panorama.
hotspot_desc_text: Panel with rich text in Markdown.
hotspot_desc_tooltip: Short bubble anchored to the point, opens nothing.
hotspot_desc_image: Full-screen photo with zoom and caption.
hotspot_desc_gallery: Series of images with previous and next.
hotspot_desc_pdf: Paginated document with zoom and download.
hotspot_desc_web: External page embedded in an isolated frame.
hotspot_desc_videoFile: Your own video, in a window or projected on the scene.
hotspot_desc_embedVideo: YouTube, Vimeo or PeerTube video without cookies.
hotspot_desc_audio: Sound with a player, or a spatial source at the point.
hotspot_desc_model3d: Rotatable 3D model, with augmented reality on mobile.
hotspot_desc_quiz: Scored question with attempts and explained feedback.
hotspot_desc_form: Form with your own fields and anti-spam.
hotspot_desc_compare: Before and after with a slider, or two scenes at once.
hotspot_search_placeholder: Search a type: text, door, quiz, 3D…
hotspot_palette_hint: Pick a type and then click on the panorama to place it.
hotspot_place_hint: Click on the panorama to place the hotspot
polygon_hint: Click to add vertices; double-click to close the polygon
alt_required: Alternative text is required to publish without warnings
category_hint: Groups scenes in the viewer menu.
label: Label
hotspot_desc_treasure: A hidden object for the visitor to find. Placing one is all it takes to start a treasure hunt.
treasure_reward_hint: Optional. Markdown allowed; if left empty the viewer congratulates anyway.
treasure_hint_hint: Optional. In the viewer, the treasure counter offers a “Hint” button that shows the one for the next pending treasure in the scene.
icon_size_hint: Left alone, it uses the tour default size.
graph_hint: Drag nodes to arrange; drag from a node edge to another node to create a connection
drag_scenes_hint: Drag scenes from the list onto the plan
export_single_multires: Not available for tours with tiled panoramas: the single HTML file can only carry equirectangular scenes. Use the standard package.
export_vr_note: The package keeps VR headset support. WebXR only works over HTTPS: upload it to a host with a certificate. The standard package must be served (any static server will do), not opened with a double click.
live_note: Audio is not transmitted: use Meet/Teams alongside and share this link.
brand_kits_intro: A brand bundles colours, typography and a logo so you can apply them to any tour at once. The built-in one is Andarama's; create your organisation's or your clients' here.
brand_logo_hint: Shown as a watermark in the viewer corner.
brand_apply_hint: Applying copies its colours, typography and logo to this tour.
hotspot_size_default_hint: Applies to every marker without its own size.
ui_titleBar_desc: The tour name at the top left, with the scene menu.
ui_sceneMenu_desc: Dropdown listing every scene, grouped by category.
ui_thumbnails_desc: Strip of thumbnails at the bottom to jump between scenes.
ui_compass_desc: Needle showing which way the visitor is looking.
ui_loadingIndicator_desc: Notice while a new scene is downloading.
ui_zoomControls_desc: Plus and minus, for people not using wheel or pinch.
ui_gyroToggle_desc: On phones, move the device to look around.
ui_vr_desc: Button to enter a headset or cardboard mode.
ui_fullscreen_desc: Fill the whole screen of the device.
ui_share_desc: Link, embed code and QR code for the current scene.
ui_help_desc: Panel with the available gestures and keyboard shortcuts.
ui_langSelector_desc: Switch the tour language, when it has more than one.
ui_accessibleMode_desc: Plain-text walkthrough, usable with a screen reader.
custom_css_hint: Injected inside the viewer. Affects this tour only.
css_guide_intro: Custom CSS is injected inside the viewer and affects this tour only. Most of it is done by changing variables; override concrete rules only when needed.
css_guide_safety: CSS is sanitised before publishing: no @import, no external url(), no expressions. An exported tour must keep working offline.
vr_settings_intro: There is no mouse in a headset: you point with your hand or a controller, and without a controller you hold your gaze. This decides what can be triggered in there.
vr_dwell_hint: Seconds looking at a marker before it triggers by itself.
vr_nav_always: Navigation is always available: without it the tour would be a still photo.
treasure_explain: A game for the visitor: hide treasures around the scenes and the viewer keeps count of the ones found. You place them like any other marker, with the “Treasure” hotspot.
token_created_note: Copy the token now; it will not be shown again.
totp_scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app and enter the generated code
confirm_delete_scene: The scene and its hotspots will be deleted. Continue?
timeline_hint: In video scenes, define when each hotspot appears
question: Question

no_media: The library is empty. Upload panoramas to get started.
use_current_view_hint: Save the current framing as the scene's initial view
position_drag_hint: Drag the marker in the preview or fine-tune the degrees here.
corners_hint: Click the 4 corners of the screen on the panorama.
corners_defined: Corners defined. Click again to redefine them.
corners_click_hint: Click each corner of the screen
audio_radius_hint: Angle around the point where the audio is heard.
strict_sandbox_hint: Recommended: isolates the embedded site. Disable only if the content needs its own cookies or session.

reconnect_source: Drag to make the step start from another scene
reconnect_duplicate: That step already exists in that scene
reconnect_same: A scene cannot lead to itself

help_reconnect: Drag the arrow ends to reconnect it

help_floorplan: Shows or hides the floor plan underneath
help_route_add: Appends the scene to the route
graph_fix_no-target: Pick a target in the inspector, or delete it.

graph_fix_unplaced: Open it in the panorama and drag it into place.
graph_fix_orphan: This scene cannot be reached from the start: connect it from another one.

unplaced_hint: This step is in a provisional spot. Open it in the panorama and drag it into place.
autopilot_click_hint: Click a scene on the canvas to append it to the route.
autopilot_empty_hint: No routes yet: click a scene on the canvas and the first route will be created with that stop.
delete_edge_hint: You can also press Delete with the connection selected.
nav_hotspot_edge_hint: This connection is defined by a navigation hotspot inside the scene.
selection_hint: Ctrl/Cmd+click toggles · Shift+click grabs the range · Esc lets go

lti_org_intro: Register your institution's platform here. From it, teachers will pick this organization's published tours and quiz scores will flow back to the gradebook. Requires a plan that includes LTI.
org_export_intro: Download a ZIP with every project, the compiled tours, form responses, quiz results and the media inventory.
backup_hint: The backup includes the full database (without media binaries). Media syncs with storage tools (rclone/aws cli); see the admin guide.
custom_domain_hint: The tour will be served at that domain's root. Create a CNAME to this instance and add the domain in Cloudflare (Custom Domains) or your proxy.
web_component_hint: Paste these two lines into any HTML — no manual iframe needed.
area_hint: Groups scenes in the graph and in the visitor menu. Add a plan and it also becomes a floor.
areas_empty: No areas yet. Create one to group scenes by floor or by zone.
areas_hint: An area groups scenes, provides the scene menu category and, with a plan, is a floor.
no_plan_yet: This tour has no floor plan yet. Upload one and drag the scenes onto it: where you drop them is where the visitor will see them on the minimap.

preview_here_start: You are in “{scene}”, at the start of the tour
treasure_none_yet: No treasures yet. Add the “Treasure” hotspot in the scene where you want to hide one and the game starts by itself.
projects_intro: Your tours, ready to be walked.
new_folder_hint: To group tours together. You can then drag tours onto it to move them in.
confirm_delete_folder_full: This folder has {n} tours. Deleting it does NOT delete them: they move out of the folder. Continue?
media_intro: Panoramas, floor plans, videos and audio for your organisation.
no_scenes_yet_hint: Drag a panorama from the library below, or press “Add scene”.
icon_rotation_hint: Degrees clockwise. It turns the drawing, not the chip.
open_mode_tour_hint: Whoever opens the link starts where the tour starts and walks at their own pace.
open_mode_kiosk_hint: For an unattended screen: the routes play in a loop and, if someone touches it, they are free to explore and it resumes on its own.
plan_intro: Andarama is open source: free on your own server. Here on andarama.com, plans pay for the house.
plan_none_hint: Pick a plan to create tours. If you would rather not pay, install Andarama at home: it is the same program.
plan_trial_hint: No card needed: one tour and 500 MB of media to try everything. When it ends, what you created stays; you only need a plan to keep creating.
plan_trial_over_hint: Your tours are still here. Pick a plan to create and publish again, or install Andarama at home: it is the same program.
plan_cap_classroom: Graded quiz with certificate, escape room and treasure hunt
capability_scorm_hint: SCORM export comes with the Formación plan.
capability_custom_domain_hint: A custom domain comes with the Excursión, Formación and Lifetime plans.
plan_admin_note: You administer this instance: your quota comes from the organisation, not from a plan.
plan_override_note: Plan granted by hand by the administrator.
plan_fair_use: Every plan has a limited number of projects and a fair-use policy: if usage stops looking like one person or a small team, we talk before cutting anything.
plan_self_host: The free plan is hosting it yourself
plan_self_host_hint: Docker and SQLite on your own server, or Cloudflare's free tier. No plan quotas.

quota_reached: You have reached the tour limit of your plan.
clerk_account_hint: Password, two-step verification and emails are managed in your Clerk account.
clerk_sign_in_hint: Clerk looks after the account: password, email code or passkey.
clerk_api_rejected: Clerk signed you in, but this instance does not accept the session. Usually the Studio and the API use different Clerk keys, or the origin is not authorised.
save_failed: Could not save: {error}. Your latest changes are not on the server.
publish_blocked: Cannot publish until this is fixed:
gallery_title: Show in the public gallery on andarama.com
gallery_hint: Your tour gets its own page at andarama.com/explorar/, written so search engines find it by the name of the place. Write the title and description in a single language.
gallery_needs_public: Only a tour with public visibility can be shown in the gallery.
gallery_field_title_hint: With the name of the place: “La Laguna Cathedral: 360 virtual tour”.
gallery_field_description_hint: One paragraph of 300 to 600 characters: what you see, where it is and what makes it special.
gallery_chars_short: {n} more characters needed to reach the minimum of {min}.
gallery_field_credits_hint: Authors and licences of the photographs, if they are not yours. Web addresses become links.
gallery_field_place_hint: City or town where the place you walk through is.
gallery_field_coords_hint: Latitude and longitude in decimal degrees. If the tour already has a map, they are filled in for you.
gallery_invalid_title: The listing title needs between 3 and 120 characters.
gallery_invalid_coords: Coordinates go together and within range (latitude ±90, longitude ±180).
import_order_hint: By name keeps the camera numbering. Dragging switches to manual.
autopilot_arrival_hint: Each stop is entered through the step that links the two scenes, with that step's arrival orientation. It waits the given seconds and turns towards the exit before moving on.
step_dwell_hint: Seconds to stay at this stop
route_loop_on_hint: Repeats forever. What an unattended screen wants.
route_loop_off_hint: Plays once, ends on the start scene and only starts again when someone asks.
autopilot_json_hint: Routes are edited in the Graph tab, Autopilot mode. This is the same raw data, in case something needs a manual tweak.
ui_autopilotButton_desc: The bottom-left “play” that runs the routes. Only shown if there is at least one.
text_title_hint: If empty, the panel uses the marker label.
tooltip_text_hint: Shown on hover and, when clicked, in a bubble pinned to the marker. No need to repeat it in “Label”.
video_ref_hint: Paste the address as is (youtu.be/…, youtube.com/watch?v=…): the ID is extracted automatically.
video_ref_invalid: That does not look like a {provider} address.
web_url_hint: Many sites refuse to be shown inside another page (banks, social networks, Google…). If it shows blank in the viewer, use the External link hotspot.
web_html_hint: Paste the “embed” code from Sketchfab, Genially, Google Maps, H5P, YouTube… A single iframe is used directly; code with scripts is shown in an isolated frame.
polygon_purpose: A zone is a free-form area on the photo (a door, a painting, a machine) that reacts to clicks. Choose what it does: go to another scene, open a website or open another point of this scene. Without an action it only highlights.
polygon_action_open_hotspot: Open another hotspot of this scene
quiz_one_per_hotspot: Each quiz marker is one question. For a questionnaire, place several in the scene or across the tour: the final report adds them all up.
gate_hint: With the gate nobody leaves this scene until they answer correctly. If there are several gated questions, all of them must be answered correctly. Exits look dimmed and clicking them opens the question.
form_purpose: A form for visitors to leave data: contact, sign-up, survey. Answers are stored in Andarama and downloaded from the Analytics tab; they can also be forwarded to a webhook or notified by email.
compare_scenes_hint: Opens both scenes side by side, in sync: turning one turns the other. Meant for a before/after of the same room (a renovation, two periods, day and night).
treasure_marker_hint: Shown as a gem. To really hide it, change the icon or remove the round background under “Style”.
coupons_hint: A coupon is a single-use code that grants its plan to whoever redeems it, with no payment gateway involved. Codes are shown in full when generated: copy or download them, though you can always look them up in the table below.
coupon_hint: If someone gave you a code, redeem it here and the plan is active straight away. No card needed.
coupon_ok: Coupon redeemed: you now have the {plan} plan.
coupon_kept_previous: Coupon redeemed, but your current plan was already better: you keep the one you had.
ui_language_hint: Saved to your account and applied on all your devices.
ui_backButton_desc: The arrow at the bottom left that returns to the previous scene.
ui_projections_desc: The globe button to view the scene as a little planet, fisheye and others. You can remove it or keep only some.
projections_allowed: Projections that can be chosen (the normal one is always available)
quiz_ask_name: Ask for the name when sending the result
quiz_ask_name_hint: When the questions are finished, each visitor's result reaches Analytics. With this option their name is asked before sending it. If the tour is opened from Moodle or another platform via LTI, the name arrives on its own and is not asked.
form_once_hint: Whoever already sent it sees “You have already sent this form” instead of the form, even if they come back another day from the same browser. The server rejects the second submission.
form_gate: Gate (do not leave the scene without sending it)
form_gate_hint: Nobody leaves this scene until the form is sent. Trying to leave opens it.
treasure_gate: Gate (do not leave the scene without finding it)
treasure_gate_hint: Nobody leaves this scene until this treasure is found. Trying to leave shows its hint.
label_too_long: In the viewer the label takes at most three lines and the rest is cut with an ellipsis. For long texts use a text hotspot.
tooltip_too_long: Under the marker three lines will show with an ellipsis; the full text appears on click, in a scrollable bubble.
trial_banner_last_day: Free trial: today is the last day.
trial_banner_over: Your free trial has ended. Your published tour is still online.
trial_over_online: Your published tour stays online, with the “Made with Andarama” badge.
trial_over_export: You can export it whenever you like: it is yours.
trial_over_locked: To edit it, republish it or upload new photos, you need a plan.
editor_plan_locked: Read only: your free trial has ended. The published tour stays online and you can export it; to edit or republish it, choose a plan.
plan_required_toast: This needs a plan. What you published stays online and you can export it.
sector_templates_hint: Sample tours by sector: they are copied to your account and you can change them as you like.
onboarding_share: Share it or embed it on your website
onboarding_no_photos: No 360 photos yet? Try the free tools or start with the example tour.
gallery_status_pending: Listing under review: it will appear in the gallery once an administrator approves it.
gallery_status_approved: Listing approved: it is visible in the gallery.
gallery_status_rejected: The listing was not approved for the gallery. The tour stays published; change the texts and publish again to resubmit it.
admin_gallery_hint: Listings asking to appear in /explorar/. Until they are approved they are neither listed nor indexed.
admin_gallery_empty: There are no listings in this state.
auth_pitch: Visual editor, one-click publishing, virtual reality and open export.
plan_chosen_hint: Confirm the payment to activate it. You can change or cancel your plan at any time.
initial_view_saved: Initial view saved: the tour will start looking here
is_start_scene: This is the tour's start scene
start_scene_first: The first one in the list
publish_slug_hint: The last part of the tour's link: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
slug_invalid: Use at least 3 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
slug_own: This is this tour's current address.
slug_taken_org: Another tour in your organization already uses this address. Try «{suggested}».
slug_taken_other: Someone else already uses this address: if you keep it, it will be published as «{suggested}».
slug_changed_org: The address «{requested}» was already used by another tour in your organization, so this one was published at «{slug}».
slug_changed_other: The address «{requested}» was already taken by someone else, so your tour was published at «{slug}». You can change it when you publish again.
media_already_scene: {count} of the media were already scenes in this tour: they were not duplicated.
rename_media_offer: Rename the photo too? «{from}» would become «{to}» in the library.
library_all_hint: Shows the media from all your tours so you can reuse them without uploading again. You can narrow it down to one tour.
library_tour_hint: Only the media uploaded to or assigned to this tour.
hotspot_try_hint: Opens the hotspot's content as the visitor will see it (with the latest saved changes)
help_hidden_scene: The scene stays in the tour and can be reached through its links, but it does not appear in the scene menu. Useful for secret rooms or in-between scenes.
help_view_limits: They restrict how far visitors can look in this scene, in radians: pitchMin and pitchMax limit looking down and up; yawMin and yawMax, turning sideways; fovMin and fovMax, the zoom. Leave them empty for no limits.
help_scene_audio: Ambient sound loops while the visitor is in the scene and crossfades into the next one. Narration plays once on entering; if you turn on «Block navigation», visitors cannot leave the scene until it ends. While editing, you can mute it with the speaker button in the canvas bar.
help_block_navigation: While the narration plays, links to other scenes are locked and the visitor is told why. Useful when the explanation is essential to continue.
help_conditions: They decide when this hotspot is shown: only in certain languages, or only when the tour variables meet a condition (for example, a door that appears once the key has been found). Variables are created in Tour settings.
help_state: The counter/state hotspot shows nothing by itself: it changes tour variables when clicked. Variables are created in Tour settings (for example, {"door_open": false, "points": 0}), and this hotspot can set them, add or subtract, or toggle true/false. Any hotspot can then be shown or hidden depending on those variables from its Conditions tab, and the counter can also take you to another scene. That is how you build doors that open when a key is found, routes that depend on what was done, or an escape room.
help_polygon: A polygon turns an area of the photo (a door, a painting, a machine part) into a clickable surface with its exact shape, instead of a point. You draw it by clicking the corners on the panorama and close it with a double click; you can choose fill colour, border, opacity and hover colour. When clicked it can take you to another scene, open a website, open another hotspot in the same scene, or just highlight.
help_quiz_gate: With the gate on, visitors cannot leave the scene until they answer correctly (or run out of attempts). Useful for escape rooms and to make sure something is understood before moving on.
help_start_scene: The scene where the tour starts. You can also set it from the scene editor or the graph. If you do not choose one, the tour starts with the first in the list. The starting orientation is that scene's initial view («Use current view»).
help_intro_effect: How the first scene appears: with no effect, with a fade, or with the «little planet», which starts looking at the photo from above and turns to the initial view.
help_passing_score: Percentage of the quiz points needed to pass. It is used in the final report, the certificate and the grade the virtual classroom receives with the SCORM package.
help_variables: Values the tour remembers during the visit (they are lost when it is closed). They are written in JSON, for example {"key": false, "points": 0}. Counter/state hotspots change them and each hotspot's conditions read them to show or hide it.
help_visibility: Public: anyone with the link, and it may appear in search engines. Unlisted: only people who have the link. Password: a password is required to enter. Organization: only signed-in members. Domains: it can only be embedded in the websites you list.
badge_question: Does the «Made with Andarama» badge show?
help_badge: The «Made with Andarama» badge appears on tours published with the free trial and the Andar, Aula and Paseo plans. The Excursión, Formación and De por vida plans include white label and do not show it. It is decided when you publish: if you change plan, publish the tour again for it to appear or disappear. Exported packages (ZIP) never carry it.
help_share_link: The direct link to the tour. Open it or paste it anywhere: an email, a chat, social media or a document.
help_embed_code: Puts the tour inside another website with an iframe. It is the universal option: it works anywhere that accepts HTML, including Moodle, WordPress or Google Sites.
help_web_component: Does the same as the embed code with a shorter tag, <anda-tour>, which adjusts its aspect ratio by itself. Use it only if you control the page HTML and can add a <script>; otherwise, use the embed code.
help_qr: Print the QR code on a poster, a worksheet or a slide: scanning it with a phone opens the tour. Download it with the button.
share_moodle_title: How to add it to Moodle
help_moodle:
1. In your course, turn editing on and add a Page or a «Text and media area» (formerly «Label»), or edit an existing one.
2. In the text editor, press the button that shows the HTML code.
3. Paste the embed code above and save.
If you also want the quiz grade to reach the gradebook, export the tour as a SCORM package and upload it as a SCORM activity.
help_live: Open a Meet or Teams call for the voice and share the attendee link there. You open the guide link (it is private: do not share it). When you change scene, turn the view or zoom, attendees follow you in their own browser, at full image quality and without the glitches of screen sharing. Each student can let go to explore and follow you again with a button. Alt + click points at a spot everyone sees, and there is a text chat. Hotspot panels and audio are not synchronized; that is why the video call is needed.
help_comments: Comments are internal review notes for the team editing the tour. Anyone with access to the project can leave a comment, link it to a scene, reply in a thread and mark it as resolved once fixed. Visitors never see them: they do not appear in the published tour. They do not send email notifications either, so check them when you open the project.
export_done_detail: Package ready: {files} files, {mb} MB, in {s} s
help_export_max_res: Lowers the resolution of tiled panoramas so the package is lighter and faster to download. «Full» keeps the original quality.
help_export_downloads: If on, image and PDF hotspots show a button so visitors can download the file. If off, the button disappears. The files stay in the package, because visitors see them inside the tour, so the size does not change.
help_export_analytics: If your institution has a server that collects statistics, paste its address here and the tour will send it the visits (scenes viewed, hotspots opened, times) as JSON. If you leave it empty, the exported tour sends no data to anyone. Most teachers should leave it empty.
help_export_sw: Adds what the tour needs to work offline once it has been opened for the first time, and to be installed as an app. Useful in a museum, a fair or a classroom without wifi: open it once with a connection and it keeps working if the connection drops. It cannot be combined with the single HTML file.
help_export_single: Produces a single index.html file with the viewer and all the photos inside, which opens with a double click without a server. «Small» means there is no fixed scene limit, but the file weighs about a third more than all its photos and videos together and the browser loads it whole into memory: as a guide, it works well below about 100 MB, usually 10 to 15 regular panoramas without video. Not available if any scene is tiled (very large photos). It can be combined with SCORM.
help_export_scorm: Produces a ZIP to upload to Moodle (or another virtual classroom) as a SCORM activity. The classroom records whether the student completed the tour (all scenes viewed or all questions answered) and their quiz score, compared with the passing score in Tour settings. Choose SCORM 1.2 if your platform is old and 2004 otherwise. It also works with the single HTML file. On andarama.com it is included in the Formación plan.
help_export_kiosk: For screens with nobody in front of them (a museum, a fair, a reception desk): the tour moves on by itself following the automatic visit and, if nobody touches it for a while, starts again.
a11y_require_alt_desc: If a scene or a hotspot has no alternative text, the tour will not publish until it does. Recommended for public bodies, which are responsible for the accessibility of what they publish.
